ingles.titulo: Did You Know the Chernobyl Explosion Changed Everything?
ingles.descripcion: On April 26, 1986, the explosion of Reactor 4 at Chernobyl altered nuclear history. With 1,661 fuel channels and a need for 42 million liters of coolant per hour, an unstable power reduction during a shutdown test caused a vapor explosion that destroyed the building. Over 500,000 people were mobilized, 237 were hospitalized, 134 suffered acute radiation syndrome, and 28 died in three months. The exclusion zone expanded to 30 km, displacing 68,000 more people.
